filtration.section.title: The path to pure perfection
filtration.section.subtitle: Our 6-stage water filtration
filtration.section.lead: Before reaching the lab and being bottled, every drop of Aqua Viva water passes through a precise six-stage purification system.
filtration.phase.label: Stage
filtration.phase1.title: Pharmaceutical micron filter
filtration.phase1.body: A pharmaceutical-grade micron filter that captures even the most microscopic residual elements.
filtration.phase2.title: Activated carbon
filtration.phase2.body: Eliminates organic contaminants, absorbs residual chlorine, and refines the taste and aroma of the water.
filtration.phase3.title: Ion exchange resin
filtration.phase3.body: Specialized resin that selectively swaps hardness ions and trace heavy metals for harmless ones, softening the water and fine-tuning its mineral balance.
filtration.phase4.title: Reverse osmosis
filtration.phase4.body: High-pressure filtration that fully removes excess minerals, salts, impurities, and trace heavy elements.
filtration.phase5.title: Ultraviolet (UV) light
filtration.phase5.body: Powerful UV disinfection that destroys 99.99% of microorganisms and bacteria without altering the composition of the water.
filtration.phase6.title: Ozonation
filtration.phase6.body: Ozone infusion delivers fully natural sterilization - lasting freshness and microbiological safety in every bottle.

about.page.title: About - SJI Group
about.page.description: SJI Group Ltd - the Bulgarian company behind Aqua Viva and Santos. Over two decades of expertise bottling premium water and refreshing drinks.
about.hero.title: Reliability, built on principles
about.hero.subtitle: Since 2000 we have been crafting beverages you can rely on - with engineering precision, scientific control, and a quiet dedication to quality.
about.story.title: A family company. Industrial precision.
about.story.lead: SJI Group Ltd is a Bulgarian company that has been turning pure water into a trusted product for more than two decades.
about.story.body1: We started in 2000 - with a small team, a clear purpose, and the conviction that every bottle has to earn the trust of the person who opens it. Over the years we invested in modern filtration systems, in independent lab control, and in people who take quality personally.
about.story.body2: In 2012 we introduced Aqua Viva - the brand that brought together our highest standards for purity, taste, and consistency. It quickly became the choice of thousands of families, offices, and partners.
about.story.body3: Today SJI Group is no longer just a manufacturer - it is a long-term partner for distributors, restaurants, hospitals, schools, and industrial clients who expect transparency, guaranteed availability, and a product that never lets them down.
about.story.pull: Quality is not an ambition. It is a habit - repeated every day, every batch, every bottle.
about.timeline.2000.title: Founded
about.timeline.2000.body: We begin operations with a focus on bottling high-quality beverages.
about.timeline.2012.title: Aqua Viva
about.timeline.2012.body: We launch our own brand of table water - a symbol of clarity and consistency.
about.timeline.today.label: Today
about.timeline.today.title: A trusted partner
about.timeline.today.body: We supply families, offices, restaurants, and industry across the country.
about.science.title: Precision, proven in the lab
about.science.intro: Before it reaches the bottle, every batch of water is fully analyzed - not as a formality, but as a responsibility. The tests are run by independent, accredited laboratories every single month.
about.science.quote: We don't trust words - we trust results. So we verify them every single month.
about.science.stat1.label: Elements analyzed
about.science.stat1.body: Microbiology, heavy metals, mineral composition, organic compounds - all traceable in writing.
about.science.stat2.label: Independent tests per year
about.science.stat2.body: External accredited laboratories run a complete analysis every month, without exception.
about.science.stat3.label: Internal monitoring
about.science.stat3.body: Continuous quality control at every stage - from source to sealed bottle.
about.filtration.title: Six stages to perfect clarity
about.filtration.intro: Every stage has its precise role. Together they form a system where nothing is left to chance - from the first mechanical filter to the final ozonation.
about.monitoring.title: Sensors that never blink
about.monitoring.lead: Quality is not a state - it is a process. Every line is equipped with sensors that run continuously and automation that reacts in fractions of a second.
about.monitoring.body: Pressure, flow, turbidity, conductivity, temperature, ozone level - every parameter is tracked and recorded in real time. At the slightest deviation the system stops the line automatically, before a single bottle leaves it.
about.monitoring.stat.label: Microbiological safety
about.monitoring.feature1.title: Sensors across the line
about.monitoring.feature1.body: Dozens of measurement points control flow, quality, and sterility.
about.monitoring.feature2.title: Automatic response
about.monitoring.feature2.body: Algorithms halt the process at the first deviation - before anyone notices.
about.monitoring.feature3.title: A transparent record
about.monitoring.feature3.body: Every batch has a full digital history - from filling to sealing.
about.closing.title: Completely pure and light.
about.closing.body: That is everything we promise. And everything we deliver every day - quietly, precisely, consistently.

kachestvo.page.title: Quality & Control - SJI
kachestvo.page.description: Six purification stages, monthly independent lab analyses, and HACCP-certified production - how SJI proves its water quality.
kachestvo.hero.title: Don't take our word for it. Verify us.
kachestvo.hero.subtitle: Every batch of water passes six purification stages and monthly independent laboratory control. Here we show how - and with what results.
kachestvo.process.title: Six stages to perfect clarity
kachestvo.process.intro: Every stage has a precise role. Together they form a system where nothing is left to chance.
kachestvo.lab.title: Results, not words
kachestvo.lab.intro: Every month an independent accredited laboratory analyzes our water across more than 100 parameters. Here is what the analysis covers:
kachestvo.lab.group1.title: Microbiology
kachestvo.lab.group1.body: Total microorganism count, coliforms, E. coli, enterococci.
kachestvo.lab.group2.title: Heavy metals
kachestvo.lab.group2.body: Lead, cadmium, mercury, arsenic, and other trace heavy elements.
kachestvo.lab.group3.title: Mineral composition
kachestvo.lab.group3.body: Calcium, magnesium, sodium, total mineralization, and hardness.
kachestvo.lab.group4.title: Organic compounds
kachestvo.lab.group4.body: Pesticides, nitrates, nitrites, and residual organic contaminants.
kachestvo.lab.placeholder.title: Monthly reports - coming here soon
kachestvo.lab.placeholder.body: We are preparing to publish the accredited laboratory's reports. Until then, you can request them at any time - we send them without hesitation.
kachestvo.haccp.title: HACCP-certified production
kachestvo.haccp.body: Production runs on the HACCP food-safety system - analysis and control of critical points at every step from filling to sealing.
kachestvo.monitoring.title: Real-time control
kachestvo.monitoring.body: Sensors track pressure, flow, and quality across the entire line. At any deviation the system stops filling automatically - before a bottle leaves the line.
kachestvo.cta.title: Questions about quality?
kachestvo.cta.body: Write to us - we answer with documents, not brochures.

faq.page.title: FAQ - SJI
faq.page.description: Answers to the most common questions about deliveries, products, quality, and business services.
faq.hero.title: Questions & answers
faq.hero.subtitle: Short, specific answers. If your question isn't here - write to us.
faq.q1.a: We deliver in Dobrich and the region. For addresses outside the region, contact us - we often find a solution.
faq.q2.q: How do I order delivery for my home or office?
faq.q2.a: Send an enquiry through the contact form or call us during business hours. We agree on quantity and day - and start regular deliveries.
faq.q3.q: What kind of water is Aqua Viva?
faq.q3.a: Aqua Viva is table water - purified through a six-stage system (mechanical filter, activated carbon, ion exchange, reverse osmosis, UV, and ozonation) and verified monthly by an independent laboratory.
faq.q4.a: Table water is drinking water with a controlled composition, purified and bottled to standard. Unlike mineral water, its quality is guaranteed not by a spring but by the purification process and constant control.
faq.q5.a: Twice over: continuous internal control on the line, and a monthly 100+ parameter analysis in an independent accredited laboratory. Reports are available on request.
faq.q6.a: Yes - repair, sanitization, and scheduled maintenance for all types of water dispensers.
faq.q7.a: Yes, we refill 60 L CO₂ cylinders for home sparkling-water machines.
faq.q8.a: They depend on the assortment and volumes. Send an enquiry and you will receive a specific offer with prices and timelines.
faq.q9.q: Can I produce water under my own brand?
faq.q9.a: Yes - we offer end-to-end production under your label in formats from 0.5 L to 19 L. Minimum quantities are negotiable.
faq.q10.a: Production is HACCP-certified, and the water is verified monthly by an accredited laboratory. Documents are available on request.

privacy.page.title: Privacy Policy - SJI
privacy.page.description: How SJI Group Ltd collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.hero.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro.body: This policy explains what personal data SJI Group Ltd collects through this website, why it is collected, and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.controller.title: Data Controller
privacy.controller.body: SJI Group Ltd, 54 Kaliakra St, Dobrich, Bulgaria. For questions about your personal data, reach us via the contact form or the details listed on the Contact page.
privacy.data.title: What data we collect
privacy.data.body: We only collect the data you voluntarily submit through the contact form: name, email address, phone (optional), and the content of your message. The site has no registration, accounts, or user tracking.
privacy.purpose.title: Why we collect it
privacy.purpose.body: We use the data solely to respond to your enquiry. We do not use it for marketing and we do not sell it or share it with third parties for their own purposes.
privacy.legal.title: Legal basis
privacy.legal.body: We process the data on the basis of your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), given via the checkbox in the contact form. You may withdraw your consent at any time.
privacy.processors.title: Data processors
privacy.processors.body: Form submissions are delivered via Formspree (Formspree Inc., USA), and spam protection is provided by hCaptcha (Intuition Machines Inc.). These services process the data solely for message delivery and abuse prevention.
privacy.retention.title: Retention
privacy.retention.body: We keep correspondence for as long as needed to answer your enquiry and a reasonable period afterwards, unless the law requires longer retention.
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
privacy.cookies.body: The site uses no tracking cookies and collects no analytics. We only store your language preference (BG/EN) locally in your browser.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict the processing of, and port your data, as well as to withdraw your consent. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP, www.cpdp.bg).
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: To exercise your rights or ask about this policy, reach us via the Contact page.
